# Theming

Modes and brands.

Accessible first has **2 modes** and **1 brand**. A mode swaps the colours; corners and type stay the same in every mode.

## The five answers

| Question | Answer | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| What can a theme change? | Mode only | One brand, so only the mode changes. |
| How many themes ship? | Two | Light and dark. |
| How are brands handled? | One brand | One service, one brand. |
| Which modes ship? | Light and dark | Light and dark ship as standard; both hold AAA text. |
| What changes when the theme changes? | Colors only | Only colors change. |

## Where it lands

- Button
- Card
- Overlay

## When to use what

| Situation | Use | Not | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Someone switches to dark | The dark semantic mode, or high contrast | One mode only | People pick the mode they can read. |
